cost.binNote: Bin's ddragon summary and section header list a flat cost of 40 for all ranks, but the wiki formula scales the cost down by champion level (40 to 23 over levels 1-18), which is by level, not by rank. This is a genuine disagreement between sources.

values.binNote: StormDamage (base [20/36/52/68/84/100], +0.35xap) appears to be exactly double this per-tick value; the wiki's per-tick base and AP ratio (17.5%) are each half of StormDamage's base/ratio (0.35). Uncertain what StormDamage itself directly represents in-engine (possibly a per-two-tick or combined value); recorded with this inferred halving.

values.meaning: Total Magic Damage (blizzard, over full duration)
values.binNote: This is 4x StormDamage's base (StormBaseDamage) and 4x its AP ratio (0.35 -> 1.4), i.e. per-tick value (see r_1) multiplied by the 8 ticks over the 4-second duration. StormDamage's own exact in-engine meaning is unresolved (see r_1 note).

values.meaning: Awaken bonus magic damage per tick, as % of target's maximum health, total over the storm's duration
values.quote: {{as|{{pp|8 + (14-8)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%}}|health}} {{as|(+ {{fd|3.5}}% per 100 AP)}} {{as|of the target's '''maximum''' health}} over the duration
values.binNote: PercentHPBlast's AP ratio in the sheet is written via StormAPRatio=0.00035, which equals 0.035% per AP, i.e. 3.5% per 100 AP, matching the wiki's coefScaling; the flat/base numbers match exactly.

No standalone DataValue for the tick interval appears among the sheet's UdyrR rows; the 8 ticks over 4s (matching the total-vs-per-tick damage multiplier of 8) implies 0.5s, consistent with the wiki text.

mechanics.claim: Storm Stance empowers Udyr's next two basic attacks to deal on-hit magic damage to nearby enemies.
mechanics.quote: empowering his next two {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} to deal

mechanics.claim: The blizzard deals damage every 0.5 seconds to nearby enemies for its duration.
mechanics.quote: deals {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds to nearby enemies

mechanics.claim: The cooldown starts on cast, but using the Awaken recast refreshes the cooldown.
mechanics.quote: Starts on-cast, but recasting refreshes the cooldown

mechanics.claim: The Awaken recast ends the blizzard and unleashes a separate storm that causes the empowered attacks to deal their damage to enemies within it, and adds bonus magic damage equal to a percentage of the target's maximum health per tick.
mechanics.quote: unleashes a glacial storm for 4 seconds that is able to move on its own, as well as causes the empowered attacks to instead deal their damage to enemies within that storm

mechanics.claim: The empowered attacks will not trigger nor be consumed if they hit a structure or ward or are parried.
mechanics.quote: The empowered attacks will not trigger nor be consumed if they hit a structure or ward or are parried.

mechanics.claim: The storm around Udyr (blizzard) and an unleashed storm from Awaken are independent and can exist simultaneously.
mechanics.quote: The storm that '''Udyr''' surrounds himself with is independent from the unleashed storm.
